goal: Create a single self-contained index.html implementing an interactive full-viewport HTML5 Canvas orbital particle simulation in dark space (#060913) with a central pulsing star, 5+ planets with fading trails, 3+ moons, 150+ twinkling background stars, a glassmorphism HUD (Play/Pause, Trails ON/OFF, Reset, speed range slider 0.2..3.0 step 0.1 default 1.0 with readout, live FPS, sim time in seconds, burst particle count), and click-to-spawn radial glowing particle bursts with damping and fade-out.
constraints: Single self-contained index.html with zero external dependencies and dark space #060913 background.
Full-viewport responsive <canvas> using requestAnimationFrame and devicePixelRatio scaling.
Central glowing star rendered with createRadialGradient and a subtle corona pulse animation.
At least 5 orbiting planets with distinct radii, speeds, colors, and fading orbital trails.
At least 3 moons or satellites orbiting planets in the system.
Twinkling background starfield containing at least 150 stars.
Glassmorphism HUD overlay with Play/Pause toggle, Trails ON/OFF toggle, and Reset buttons.
Speed slider <input type="range" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0"> with live multiplier readout.
Live HUD telemetry showing FPS, simulation time in seconds, and active burst particle count.
Canvas click spawns a radial burst of glowing particles with velocity damping and fade-out.
